verdict.rationale: Kong's own documented Event Hooks can be configured to listen for Gateway entity events and run handlers automatically in the background: webhook POSTs, logs, or custom Lua `lambda` code. That is a narrow form of autonomous, event-driven automation. Audit-log webhooks stream logs on their own but are delivery, not user-defined automations. decK, Terraform and kongctl are tools users run themselves in pipelines, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: general-purpose or scheduled automation or workflow builder, agent-driven background tasks beyond entity-change triggers, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
